name: 04347 · Hallowell, ME
findings: ZIP 04347 (Hallowell) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (57% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 04347 (Hallowell) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 04347 (Hallowell) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.
